rule: A free-function prototype whose definition is not in the scan (a C header declaring a library function) is still medium. **high**: the callee is a function/method/constructor defined in the scanned source (the tool matched it to a definition). **C / Objective-C**: function-like macros → call_type macro (high if `#define`d in the scan). C functions bare;
notes: codec_decode is only prototyped in the scanned header codec.h, with no definition anywhere in src/: Decisions 2026-11-09 say such a prototype is still medium. codec_encode has a body in codec.c, so it is high. '#ifndef/#define CODEC_H' are object-like preprocessor directives, not macro invocations.
